lessons: Premise is false: the ticket fences to CLAUDE.md and excludes CHUPA_PLAN.md, but the plan's section 17 rule table says CLAUDE.md is authored from section 17 and that a change edits the plan, never the rendered file. Do not retry the CLAUDE.md-only edit.

CHUPA_PLAN.md section 17, seed rule set B, states the current Supervising session rule, including 'a ticket edit following a committed plan fix it applies itself'. A rewritten ticket must replace that text in the plan and add CHUPA_PLAN.md to its Scope fence and Scope in.

The new ./dev.py rule must also be added to section 17 rule set B, so the plan can reproduce it. Add an acceptance criterion that section 17 and CLAUDE.md section B state both rules, and drop CHUPA_PLAN.md from Scope out.

Keep AGENTS.md out only if a human confirms it. Section 17 says a rule add/change/remove touches both files once AGENTS.md exists, while the ticket says AGENTS.md carries no session rules. Check that file before authoring the replacement ticket.
